name: Rochester
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Rochester for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events. Rochester's page carries a Christmas Carol show, the Hometown Christmas parade, breakfast with Santa, Winter Wonder Lights, the Big Bright Light Show, Santa Saturdays, and now Holiday Walk (November 27 to December 30) and Family Nights (four Sundays, kids 12 and under free with a code) at Meadow Brook Hall. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Rochester

  • 9 Christmas events for kids in Rochester
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa at Royal Park, Santa Saturdays
  • Parades: Rochester Area Hometown Christmas Parade
  • Lights: Winter Wonder Lights, Family Nights and the Big Bright Light Show
  • Indoors: Holiday Walk at Meadow Brook Hall
